input: Help me write a 15-second single-shot prompt: a female mech warrior raises an energy shield in a thunderstorm at a rainy dock. Gritty hard sci-fi, battle-damaged, live-action feel.
I want a 15s robot transformation. Green color palette, energy core in the belt buckle, post-apocalyptic jungle background.
Write a weapon-charge-then-combat sequence in two segments: a lone warrior charges a heavy energy weapon, then fights. Cinematic, weighty impacts.
A multi-shot narrative short: a small salvage robot wanders into an abandoned seaside bar at dusk and is startled by a noise behind the counter.
我想做一个催泪的萌宠亲情短片：一只狗从小奶狗陪伴一个孩子长大，直到狗老去。多分镜叙事，要克制不煽情。
Write a beat-driven product commercial prompt: a wristwatch reveal, macro shots of the metal band and dial, ending on the full product hero shot. Premium, tactile, no floating-in-void CG look.
Write a found-footage horror prompt: a fixed security camera watching an empty office hallway at night, something changes very slightly between frames. No jumpscare gore.
I want a stop-motion claymation prompt, 12fps stepped animation, a small clay fox character walking through a handmade forest set. Tactile, imperfect, no smooth CG motion.
Write a music video prompt: a singer performing on a rooftop at sunset, beat-synced multi-shot cuts, bold single color grade. The track's beat should drive the edit.
竖屏短剧提示词：两人在餐厅对峙，一句台词后镜头切给对方的反应，2 秒内要有冷开场钩子，结尾留悬念。
Hard sci-fi prompt: an astronaut drifts in zero gravity outside a damaged space station, vast scale, vacuum silence, no game-cutscene look.
Write an atmospheric cyberpunk city prompt — a rain-soaked neon metropolis at night, no clear protagonist, the city itself is the subject. Volumetric haze, teal-and-orange grade.
